Jets Sign Quarterback Will Levis to Practice Squad

The New York Jets have signed former Tennessee Titans quarterback Will Levis to their practice squad. The team also released quarterback Bailey Zappe. Levis joins the Jets with the aim of developing his potential under the team's coaching staff.
